name: VectorDB Engine
project_type: Custom Vector Database and Local RAG Pipeline

overview.value: VectorDB Engine is a custom vector database and local RAG pipeline implemented in Python. The project focuses on vector search, approximate nearest-neighbor indexing, embeddings, retrieval, and RAG without relying on a managed vector database service.

api_layer.purpose: Exposes vector search and RAG functionality through REST endpoints.

embedding.purpose: Converts source text and user queries into 384-dimensional embedding vectors.

generation.purpose: Generates answers using retrieved context in the local RAG pipeline.

indexing.purpose: Provides approximate nearest-neighbor search over the stored embedding vectors.

deployment.communication: The containerized application communicates with the host-level Ollama process through host.docker.internal.

ingestion: Source content is divided into chunks.
Ollama generates 384-dimensional embeddings for the chunks.
The vectors are inserted into the custom HNSW index.
query_processing: The user's question is converted into a 384-dimensional query vector.
HNSW searches the graph for approximate nearest-neighbor candidates.
Candidate results are refined using cosine similarity.
Hybrid keyword scoring can improve exact-name or identifier matching.
Retrieved context is added to the RAG prompt.
The local LLM generates the final response.

hnsw.implementation: Custom implementation built from scratch in Python
hnsw.search_behavior: Search starts from an upper-level entry point and moves toward lower layers to identify candidate neighbors.

hybrid_search.method: Combines vector similarity with exact-match keyword scoring.
hybrid_search.purpose: Helps improve relevance when specific identifiers, names, or exact terms should receive additional weight.

flow: Generate the final answer using the local language model

privacy.value: The embedding and generation pipeline runs locally through Ollama rather than relying on a managed external vector database service.

build_hnsw_from_scratch.reason: Building the index from scratch provided an opportunity to understand the underlying mechanics of approximate nearest-neighbor indexing instead of relying entirely on a pre-built HNSW library.

ollama.reason: Ollama allows the embedding and generation components to run locally.

docker.reason: Docker provides a consistent environment for running the API and vector-search components.

hybrid_search.reason: Semantic similarity supports conceptual matching, while exact keyword matching can help prioritize specific identifiers and names.

performance.measurement_scope: Custom HNSW search under the benchmark conditions documented for the project.
